answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 46487 Country: India Title: Use of Haram Money Question: I want to know about use of haram money (Jua's Ruppees). Someone asked me that, can we use haram paisa in "Islamic Jalsa" or in other Islamic activities? I asked this question to someone and he said yes we can use haram money in Islamic Jalsa. Is it true or what? Please tell me about it. Answer ID: 46487 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1135/880/B=1434) The money earned by haram source is impure and haram. It is not lawful to use such haram money for Islamic functions or other Islamic activities. According to Shariah, the use of haram money is to give it in charity to the poor and needy ones. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
